title: The acceptance verbs enforce less than the docs promise: at green from to-write, at na on a test row, silent closes on a placeholder objective
body:
From vc's working-with-llms audit, driven:

- `at green` from `to-write` succeeds. Red-first is an owed guard (`transitions.rs:666`).
- `at na` accepts a test-backed row, and `at red|green` accept a non-test one.
- `st done` and `wp done` close silently on a placeholder objective, though `model.rs:497` computes the condition and `/in-finish` promises the warning.
- `.intent_critic.yml`'s `show_all` is read only by the subagent prompts.

Line numbers as at the audit.

Found by hv's estate-wide doc audit of 2026-09-11 (the audit's orders are in `intent/history/20260911-doc-audit.md`), where it is described as built. Carried in `intent/wip.md` as an unruled defect until 2026-09-13, when that file was leaned and every open defect became an issue. Not worked until hv rules it; a ruled one gets a lane.


**CLOSED 2026-09-14 17:54Z (ic, on vc's batch order and rulings).** Fixed in the commit carrying this note, all four halves. (a) `at green` is reachable only from `red`: the `at.set` edge to green declares `from: [red]`, and `at_set` consults it through a target-aware `transitions::permits_to`, since every `at.set` edge shares one verb. data-model.md's Machine 5 table says so under a dated note, listed for hv, who ratified that table. (b) `at na` refuses a test row and `at red|green` a non-test row, with `FacadeError::VerdictWrongForKind`. That closed the only route between kinds, so on vc's rulings a re-kind now re-enters the status at `AtStatus::entry` (to-write for a test row, n/a for a non-test row) instead of refusing, the mirror of issue 0346, and `FileOnANonTestRow`'s remedy is one call. `at new` starts a row at its kind's entry when no `--status` is given (the register's fixed `to-write` default is gone) and refuses a status the kind cannot hold. `AcceptanceTest.kind` is a `Disposition::State` whose edges are the (kind, status) pair's transition, citing hv's fold of 2026-08-17 (a transcription question listed for hv), with data-model.md's as-built column corrected for both kind fields. (c) `st done` and `wp done` warn with `Note::UnwrittenObjective` when the unit's objective is still unwritten, and `in-finish` says so again instead of telling the reader to check by hand. (d) The gate honours `show_all: true` as `severity_min: style`, an explicit `severity_min` winning, in both hook copies, and the docs say the gate reads it. Reproduced first with the delivered 3.0.3 pair: green from to-write, n/a on a test row and green on a non-test row all landed at rc 0; the close printed no warning; nothing in Rust read `show_all`. Proved by `close_and_verdict_verbs_enforce_what_they_promise.rs`.
